name: Cable Single-Arm Incline Bench Press
steps: Recline on an incline bench beside a low pulley with its handle at the side of your upper chest.
Press upward until the handle is above your upper chest.
Guide your elbow down to return the handle to its starting position.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep both feet planted and your trunk square.
Keep your shoulder blades resting on the pad and your wrist stacked over your elbow.
